requirements.statement: For each cryptic content (ASCII art, emoticon, cryptic syntax) that has an alternative, that alternative is relevant.

citations.quote: Dans chaque page web, chaque contenu cryptique (art ASCII, émoticône, syntaxe cryptique) vérifie-t-il une de ces conditions ?
pour chaque contenu cryptique (art ASCII, émoticône, syntaxe cryptique) ayant une alternative, cette alternative est-elle pertinente ?

routes.statement: The content of the title attribute is relevant.

citations.quote: Le contenu de l’attribut `title` est pertinent

routes.statement: The definition given by the adjacent context is relevant.

citations.quote: La définition donnée par le contexte adjacent est pertinente.

rationale.text: The test has one requirement with two routes, and both ask whether a definition is relevant ("pertinent"), which is judgment about meaning. Which content is cryptic is judgment too, since the wording only gives examples. An empty title attribute on a cryptic content is not a mechanical fault either: the adjacent context may still give a relevant definition, and recognising the content as cryptic already needs a reader. So no check is linked and the entry is none. No axe rule is tagged for this test. Applicability is judgment: the test applies only to cryptic content that has an alternative. Needs is empty.

citations.quote: Pour chaque contenu cryptique, vérifier que la définition donnée est pertinente.
